topics.label: Lecture introduction and cancer hallmarks framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its learning outcomes, context, and the Hanahan and Weinberg hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream cascades promote independent cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation block in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells experience blocks in terminal differentiation, illustrating the process in hematopoietic leukemias and intestinal epithelial architecture.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms by which cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53, Bax, and BCL2 signaling.

topics.label: Replicative immortality and senescence signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells achieve replicative immortality by overcoming telomere shortening and the p53-mediated stress signaling that normally enforces senescence.

topics.label: Complex hallmarks and metabolic reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the complex functional hallmarks of cancer and examine how metabolic reprogramming through aerobic glycolysis and enzyme mutations supports tumor growth.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the requirement for new blood vessel growth to sustain tumor expansion, its timing during lesion progression, and the balance of its regulatory factors.

topics.label: Cancer invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the metastatic cascade, diagnostic detection of disseminated cells, and the biological factors that govern distant colonization.

topics.label: Closing remarks and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by summarising the convergence of cancer hallmarks and providing closing practical instructions.
